headline:
Every name
has a story.
intro: Where did it come from? What stories surround it? Explore the history of names and surnames, one source at a time.
hint: Enter at least two characters. Accents are optional.
empty: No published entry matches yet. Try another spelling.
error: The archive is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
principleText: Historical explanations, folk traditions and literary stories each have a place. We distinguish them and show their sources and certainty. A legend is not historical proof.
noDetails: No further material has been published for this entry yet.
calendarNote: Dates belong to the named calendar and tradition; Julian dates are not converted to Gregorian dates.
culturalNotice: Legends, mythology and fiction reflect narratives from the cited sources. They do not automatically establish a name’s origin.

admin.title: Editorial desk
admin.intro: Manage entries, their sources and links. New imports remain drafts until an editor publishes them.
admin.error: The operation failed. Check values, references and permissions.
admin.validation: The backend rejected the values. Check required fields, reference IDs and publication rules.
admin.conflict: The record has linked data or synchronization is running. Check references and retry.
admin.unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
admin.forbidden: You do not have permission for this operation.
admin.help: Fields marked * are required. Use IDs from the corresponding section for references. Publishing cultural texts requires a web citation, license and attribution.
admin.resetConfirm: Reset this job to the start? Existing imported records will be kept.
admin.purgeConfirm: Permanently and irreversibly delete this record?
admin.syncHelp: Completes all remaining batches of enabled jobs that are due in the background. Batches continue automatically; the interval applies between complete passes. New texts remain drafts.
admin.syncStatusError: Could not load status. Retrying shortly.
admin.syncStartError: Could not confirm launch. Check job status.
admin.publishSkippedHelp: Check the listed records and complete the information required for publication.
admin.publishError: Publication could not be confirmed. Refresh the list and check the status.
